queries: WITH counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS record_count FROM constructors c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality) SELECT constructorId, nationality, record_count, record_count - (SELECT AVG(record_count * 1.0) FROM counts) AS diff_from_avg FROM counts ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT co.constructorId, co.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS cnt FROM constructors co LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.constructorId = co.constructorId GROUP BY co.constructorId, co.nationality) SELECT constructorId, nationality, cnt AS record_count, cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM c) AS diff_from_avg FROM c ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

responses.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS record_count FROM constructors c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality) SELECT constructorId, nationality, record_count, record_count - (SELECT AVG(record_count * 1.0) FROM counts) AS diff_from_avg FROM counts ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each row in constructorStandings counts as one standings record (one per constructor per race); the average is taken over all constructors in the constructors table, including those with 0 records.
Ties at the 10th place are broken arbitrarily by LIMIT 10.
